About

I'm a Marketing Communication student in Jakarta (Dean's List 2025) with hands-on experience in event planning, content creation, and research-driven campaigns. Through International Marketing Community of BINUS (IMCB), I've helped organize a 5-day school outreach program, handled logistics, and promoted national competitions. I also served as CTO of a student venture project (a smart trash bin) and co-authored research on Gen Z buying behavior — I like turning survey and social media data into a clear plan for what to say next.

I've been editing videos since junior high, individually and in group projects, whenever a task called for it. I'm looking for a marketing or communication role where I can apply all of this and keep growing.

Business research course, 2025 to 2026

Social Media Trends & Impulsive Buying (Gen Z)

Co-authored a quantitative research paper on how social media trends — FOMO, influencer marketing, and platforms like TikTok and Shopee — drive impulsive buying behavior among Gen Z university students. Ran a social media listening analysis alongside the survey to track real-time discourse around overconsumption and emerging counter-movements like deinfluencing and underconsumption.
